g.title: project
g.text: READY candidates need selection · thesis STOPPED · semantic dashboard owns the detailed view

a.xlink:title: Project completion requires supported and readable selected thesis claims, truthful code/data/reproduction and availability promises, a frozen candidate meeting the recorded human PASS threshold, required delivery/archive dispositions, and released assignments. This map does not assert any present whole-project readiness. blocker: Workflow implementation/acceptance, thesis source/support/human PASS, code/evidence and reproduction checks, actual delivery/archive dispositions and final session release remain unfinished. plan_gap: Source-backed completion model needs Jörn’s selection of bounded execution windows. Current administrative status is unknown; the scientific synthesis remains a dated unreconciled 25 September snapshot. project: msc-math authorization: Outcome map selected; thesis execution and external delivery are not authorized. next_step: Use the project branches to select useful bounded work in separate worktrees; do not restart the stopped thesis run automatically. Sources: docs/coordination/thesis-work.md, docs/coordination/handoff.md, docs/project-facts.md, ARCHITECTURE.md

Selected project-local skills and workflow deliverables integrated and working against the agreed support contract, with evidence and caveats retained; all assignments closed and their sessions released. Plans alone do not establish readiness. Thesis execution remains STOPPED. blocker: Selected completion package and acceptance criteria are not agreed; delivery, acceptance and session release remain unfinished. project: workflows authorization: Only the recorded selected assignment is authorized; future activation/execution remains separately selected. next_step: Select the reviewed local migration and acceptance package; workflow readiness is one subproject, not whole-project completion. Sources: docs/development-environments.md, docs/coordination/handoff.md

Coordinator reconciles selected outcomes and caveats, current scientific synthesis when its sources/route change, retained completion evidence and continuation constraints; release all project-owned assignments/sessions. No effective approval is recorded; numeric budget thresholds are a separate unresolved subject. owner: 01a0f18c-14b4-78e2-a7ef-91e0d7b23f0a project: workflows authorization: Only the recorded selected assignment is authorized; future activation/execution remains separately selected. next_step: Receiving coordinator completes proposal presentation; preserve discuss-first scope without inventing gates for small already-authorized work. State confirmed coverage and deferred coverage separately. owner: 01a0f18c-14b4-78e2-a7ef-91e0d7b23f0a project: workflows authorization: Only the recorded selected assignment is authorized; future activation/execution remains separately selected. next_step: Use direct chat for user questions, available verified worker transports for handoffs, and report historical cause as unknown. Review intended live settings and separate runtime trust/tooltip state before proposing a focused dotfiles disposition; preserve originals until then. Retain explicitly accepted historical limitations; smoke success is not full evidence. blocker: Playbook completeness versus thesis promises is unverified; no scoped clean-environment verification package is selected. plan_gap: Missing completeness evidence is an open question, not a confirmed broken producer or automatic permission for costly reruns. project: reproduction authorization: Completion criterion mapped; no autonomous thesis run or external delivery is authorized. Overall DS scope is still unresolved. project: thesis authorization: Completion criterion mapped; no autonomous thesis run or external delivery is authorized. next_step: Present exact current-source scope choices separately from reader concerns and optional research. Original joint design remains open; unilateral bounded-pass completion claim withdrawn and Fix session informed. Original CVs and disputed timing-chain report are absent. Historical telemetry remains explicitly a retained corrected response; original raw scratch report is no longer present. Packet does not establish a complete census, adequate-context reviewer quality or accepted final design. Existing capabilities can be reused; implementation and unapproved programmes remain stopped. owner: 01a102d8-49d5-7993-a2bf-2ffc48a55e62 project: workflows authorization: Jörn requested log review and joint brainstorming/design. Bounded source inspection and isolated probe only; approval precedes deployment. No source build, new permanent service, config activation or daemon restart. Jörn approved applying the messaging rules to project guidance; Stop-hook activation remains unapproved. Jörn selected skill placement conditional on clarity to fresh agents; bounded fresh-context checks completed. next_step: Resource stop relayed by Fix orchestration: current analysis/planning stopped and the running evidence child interrupted. Existing artifacts and unfinished joint-design obligation preserved. Resume only on renewed instruction; no completion, new programme or spending approval implied. Separately authorized reset timers are untouched. Sources: docs/codex.md, docs/coordination/README.md

Technical assessment/repairs and bounded delivery checks returned; Jörn graded this attempt FAIL. Earlier root/supervisor completion claims do not establish human acceptance of the workflow. Retained evidence: owned-response/fork/counter repairs,20 focused native-reader tests, selected-root projection compatibility, fresh-agent command/interpretation discovery, three root/worker usage-note receipts, and actual time/context-tool delivery. C hook remains withdrawn and inactive. Repeated objective drift, rejected overbuilding, scope takeover and premature endings remain session failures; useful component checks do not cancel that verdict. At closure Jörn questioned giving up and explicitly requested notifying Fix Codex thread orchestration. Root’s earlier ending was its own choice, not an explicit user cancellation. The requested notification was accepted through native tool-output transport by existing orchestration thread01a103dc-762f-7ef1-a094-4b0247b290ff; receipt not yet verified. plan_gap: Workflow acceptance failed for this attempt. No further root execution or invented approval question selected at closure. Permanent/all-agent coverage, native export deduplication, active-work/task joins and quota/billing conversion remain unestablished. Technical artifacts are retained without a PASS/readiness claim. project: workflows authorization: Jörn requested checking available scripts and applicable other-session ownership for passive resource attribution. Bounded read-only observation and correction of an attribution grouping defect; no quota experiment, new service or budget enforcement selected. Follow-up bounded readiness review covers discoverability, automation, session-log attribution, trust and fork behavior; it does not activate a new service, hook, skill, goal or quota experiment. Jörn explicitly instructed fixing the reproduced defects at 21:13 UTC on 3 October. Reporting at task start/handoff was rejected; no automatic delivery mechanism was approved. Jörn explicitly objected to stopping with incomplete work at 21:25 UTC and directed continued workflow completion, allowing a specific question/blocker when necessary. Bounded implementation and delivery investigation continue; config approval boundary remains. Completion is scoped to the original local script-readiness/fork/discoverability/interpretation questions and subsequent supervised ongoing-work observation; no broader service, scientific run or spending selected. next_step: Existing Fix orchestration owner receives the failed-attempt result and Jörn’s objection to giving up; no assignment transfer, extra spending or cancellation inferred from sending this report. Explicitly authorized conditional attempt scheduled and active for 4 October 2026 04:00 Berlin (02:00 UTC), targeting only the reset expiring at 04:36. Fresh read-only check passed at 21:34:18 UTC (four available resets, weekly usage 3%). Installed reviewed script/config in private host state; validated units and next-elapse. Service has not started and no real redemption request has been sent. Server acceptance remains unknown and user accepted possible failure. Actual systemd execution environment was additionally checked in read-only mode at 21:53:55 UTC; service exited successfully without consumption. Final reliability update: at most three transport attempts with identical credit/key, atomic result checkpoints before/after the consumption response, and a 300-second service timeout. Ten mock checks pass, including ambiguous-response retry and preservation of confirmed success if refresh fails. Installed code passed a fresh read-only systemd launch. Timer remains active for 04:00 Berlin; real redemption is pending. Claude Code fallback timer codex-reset-0400-claude.timer is installed and active for the same 4 October 04:00 Berlin trigger. It waits for the primary (up to 305 seconds), skips confirmed success or semantic refusal, and otherwise launches one bounded 120-second Claude session restricted to the existing pinned script command. A fresh process reuses exactly the primary credit/idempotency key. Six guard/command checks and an actual-systemd read-only launcher check passed. Claude auth status remains loggedIn=false: the fallback currently has an authentication blocker and is expected to fail at startup unless a valid login is available at execution. No login, model call or redemption was made during setup. Normal Claude subscription login (claude auth login --claudeai) has now been started; it is waiting for user sign-in/code completion. No successful authentication or model call has been established. The browser inspection call did not return and was terminated. The primary reset timer is independent of this pending login. Claude subscription login completed successfully after the user supplied the normal one-time authorization code. An actual-systemd read-only fallback check now reports claude_logged_in=true and exit 0. This resolves the earlier login blocker; both timers are still active for 4 October 04:00 Berlin. No Claude model call or reset consumption was made during authentication verification. owner: host systemd user timers codex-reset-0400.timer and codex-reset-0400-claude.timer project: workflows authorization: User authorized the conditional 04:00 attempt and requested considering a scheduled Claude Code session as an additional route. Primary and bounded Claude fallback use one logical pinned earned-reset redemption with the identical credit/key. Claude fallback may launch one session for at most 120 seconds after local failure; only the exact existing script command is allowed. No other credit, purchase, login, semantic-refusal retry, repository edits or other agents/model turns are authorized for this job. next_step: Both timers trigger at 04:00 Berlin. Primary writes private result.json; the now-authenticated Claude fallback skips success or server refusal and otherwise attempts the same pinned command after local failure, recording claude-result.json. Host must be awake/online. Actual server acceptance is established only by the primary command response. Sources: docs/coordination/README.md
